title: Urban Comfort Series - 1 Bedroom Apartment
content: Located at Merit Piassa Apartments near Friendship Park, the Urban Comfort Series 1-Bedroom unit offers a compact, highly functional 49 m² gross area (44 m² net usable area). The exact layout dimensions are: Living & Dining (14 sqm), Kitchen (6 sqm), Bedroom (12 sqm), Bathroom (7 sqm), Balcony One (2 sqm), and Balcony Two (3 sqm). It features a comfortable bedroom with built-in storage, a cozy living area, a modern kitchen with energy-efficient appliances, and premium bathroom fittings. It is ideal for individuals or couples seeking an affordable yet sophisticated urban experience.

title: Harmony Haven Collection - 2 Bedroom Apartment
content: The Harmony Haven Collection (also referred to as Harmony Heaven) 2-Bedroom unit at Merit Piassa Apartments spans a generous 95 m² gross area (75 m² net usable area), perfect for small families or roommates. The precise structural floor plan includes: Living & Dining (24 sqm), Kitchen (9 sqm), Master Bedroom One (15 sqm), Master Bathroom (6 sqm), Bedroom One (9 sqm), Common Bath (6 sqm), Corridor (3 sqm), and a Private Balcony (3 sqm). Features include ample natural light, built-in wardrobes, a modern kitchen with durable finishes, and contemporary home technologies.

title: Grand Vista Collection - 3 Bedroom Luxury Apartment
content: The Grand Vista Collection 3-Bedroom unit represents the pinnacle of premium urban luxury at Merit Piassa Apartments, offering a spacious 130 m² gross area (105 m² net usable area). This layout is optimized for larger families and includes a dedicated maid's room. Dimensions are: Living & Dining (29 sqm), Kitchen (10 sqm), Private Balcony (4 sqm), Master Bedroom (17 sqm), Master Bathroom (9 sqm), Bedroom One (12 sqm), Bedroom Two (11 sqm), Common Bathroom (7 sqm), and Maid's Room (6 sqm). Features include an en-suite master bathroom, premium finishes, and large open living spaces for entertaining.
